summary: Verified new rename-course / rename-doc edit buttons (iteration 22). ALL scenarios PASS on desktop 1280x800 and mobile 390x844 against the live preview URL. Login via UI (test@copythat.app / 246810). Desktop: created TEST_Rename -> rename-course opens rename-modal; Spara is disabled when input is unchanged AND when empty; typing new name + Spara closes modal, header + sidebar immediately show new name, and reload confirms persistence. rename-cancel closes without change; tapping outside the card (backdrop Pressable) also closes without change. critical_code_review_comments: RenameModal.tsx: `valid = name.trim().length > 0 && name.trim() !== initial` correctly disables Spara both for empty input and for unchanged value — verified in UI.
RenameModal.tsx: full-screen Pressable with StyleSheet.absoluteFill behind the card gives correct tap-outside-to-close behaviour (verified).

archive.tsx DocCard: rename pencil is a nested Pressable inside the card Pressable; on web the inner Pressable correctly stops propagation so tapping the pencil does NOT navigate to /doc/<id> (verified — URL stayed on /archive).
archive.tsx rename(): correctly uses PATCH /api/courses/{id} with {name} and PATCH /api/documents/{id} with {title}, and updates state locally for immediate UI feedback; also persists on reload.
doc/[id].tsx: doc-rename pencil calls titleRef.current?.focus() which places the native caret in the TextInput; saveTitle fires on both onBlur and onSubmitEditing (Enter) — both paths verified.
